source.title: The Old Champ
source.description:
This arena may not look like much, but I'll tell ya, this place used to be quite the attraction. Prize fighters, adventurers, even a few cartel folks, would all step into the ring for a chance at coin and glory.

Between the gambling and concessions, I was making a killing!

Things started to die down after the old champ, Kajind, retired, though. He was a real serious type; left for Azshara one day without a word. If you found him, we could get the arena back up and running again.
source.completion:
<A wistful expression briefly crosses Kajind's face>

Indeed, I am the so-called "champ" you seek.
